reason: Conversation 2 correctly identified E011 as a held-key fault on the first turn, gave the exact sensible first step (dry the panel, remove obstructions, power-cycle at the isolator), resolved the fault with no part needed, and only escalated to Bosch Service conditionally if the code recurred with a dry panel. Conversation 1 ignored the homeowner's volunteered clue about wet-cleaning the panel, asked irrelevant clock and key-lock questions, and then wrongly concluded a selector/control unit fault requiring an engineer, leaving the problem unresolved and steering the homeowner toward an unnecessary service call.
